name: oven-ding
description: Oven-timer ting when Claude finishes, a double ting when it needs you, phone push when you're away, and a tally of how long Claude waited for you

ntfyTopic.title: Phone push: ntfy topic
ntfyTopic.description: Topic name you subscribed to in the ntfy phone app (pick something long and random). Empty = no phone push.

awayAfterMinutes.title: Away after (minutes)
awayAfterMinutes.description: You count as away when you haven't typed for this long; then you also get a phone push

remindAfterMinutes.title: Remind after (minutes)
remindAfterMinutes.description: If Claude is still waiting on you after this long, ting again and push to your phone

minTurnSeconds.title: Ding only after turns longer than (seconds)
minTurnSeconds.description: Quick replies shorter than this stay silent. 0 = ding after every reply
